newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Bangchak refinery issues tender to buy June crude.
newsitem.headline: Bangchak refinery issues tender to buy June crude.

text.p: The 120,000 barrels-per-day Thai refiner Bangchak Petroleum Plc has issued a tender to buy June loading Far East and Middle East crude oil, traders said on Thursday.
The tender seeks 600,000 barrels of Far East light sweet crude and 500,000 barrels of Middle East crude oil.
The tender closes on Monday and offers should be valid for one day.
In its May tender, Bangchak awarded 750,000 barrels of Al Shaheem crude from an equity producer.
